// Translated by CodeBreaker from Generics (csharp).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Corpus.Generics
{
    public delegate int Combine(int a, int b);

    public class Stack<T>
    {
        private T[] items = new T[2];
        private int count;

        public int Count => count;

        public void Push(T x)
        {
            if (count == items.Length)
            {
                T[] bigger = new T[items.Length * 2];
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                {
                    bigger[i] = items[i];
                }
                items = bigger;
            }
            items[count++] = x;
        }

        public T Pop()
        {
            if (count == 0)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("empty");
            }
            return items[--count];
        }

        public T this[int i]
        {
            get => items[count - 1 - i];
            set => items[count - 1 - i] = value;
        }
    }

    public class Best<T>
        where T : IComparable<T>
    {
        public T Value { get; private set; }

        public bool Has { get; private set; }

        public void Offer(T x)
        {
            if (!Has || x.CompareTo(Value) > 0)
            {
                Value = x;
                Has = true;
            }
        }
    }

    public static class Program
    {
        static T Apply<T>(T x, Func<T, T> f, int times)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < times; i++)
            {
                x = f(x);
            }
            return x;
        }

        static int Fold(int[] xs, int seed, Combine c)
        {
            int acc = seed;
            foreach (int x in xs)
            {
                acc = c(acc, x);
            }
            return acc;
        }

        static int Mul(int a, int b) => a * b;

        public static void Main()
        {
            var s = new Stack<string>();
            s.Push("a");
            s.Push("b");
            s.Push("c");
            s[0] = "C";
            Console.WriteLine($"{s.Count} top={s[0]} pop={s.Pop()} then={s.Pop()}");
            var best = new Best<int>();
            foreach (int x in new int[] { 4, 9, 2, 7 })
            {
                best.Offer(x);
            }
            Console.WriteLine("best " + best.Value);
            var words = new Best<string>();
            words.Offer("pear");
            words.Offer("apple");
            words.Offer("zebra");
            Console.WriteLine("last word " + words.Value);
            int bonus = 3;
            Func<int, int> addBonus = v => v + bonus;
            bonus = 5;
            Console.WriteLine("apply " + Apply(1, addBonus, 4));
            Console.WriteLine("apply str " + Apply("x", t => t + "y", 3));
            int[] xs = new int[] { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };
            Console.WriteLine($"sum {Fold(xs, 0, (a, b) => a + b)} product {Fold(xs, 1, Program.Mul)}");
            var counts = new Dictionary<string, int>();
            foreach (string w in new string[] { "x", "y", "x", "z", "x", "y" })
            {
                int c;
                if (counts.TryGetValue(w, out c))
                {
                    counts[w] = c + 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    counts[w] = 1;
                }
            }
            Console.WriteLine($"x={counts["x"]} y={counts["y"]} z={counts["z"]} keys={counts.Count}");
            var log = new List<string>();
            Action<string> say = m =>
{
    log.Add($"[{m}]");
    return;
};
            say("one");
            say("two");
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(",", log));
        }
    }
}
